post.description: Rate limited per taxpayer: a budget of submissions per minute (Efis:RateLimits:DocumentWritesPerMinute, 600 unless the deployment says otherwise), per caller of a taxpayer; a batch costs one per document and is refused whole when it does not fit. Every answer carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset; a refusal is 429 rate_limited with Retry-After, and spends no number.

get.description: Without filters, every document of the taxpayer (DocumentListResponse). With any of state (comma-separated), issuedFrom, issuedTo (timestamps with an offset; half-open), businessUnit, limit (1-500, default 100) or after (the previous page's next), one page in the order documents were written, the same shape plus next, the cursor for the following page: the poller's read, which returns every document exactly once.

get.description: The e-invoice built from one document, if it has one.
The invoice as printed for the customer, in the order and wording Instruction 16/2020 Art. 9 sets.

post.description: The caller's own invoice PDF (base64 in pdf) with the verification QR of Instruction 16/2020 Art. 12 and the elements of Art. 9 the caller's template cannot know -- the invoice number, the authority's registration code and the issuer's security code -- stamped on its first page. The stamp is an incremental update: the answer begins with the uploaded bytes, unchanged. An encrypted PDF, one whose last cross-reference section is a cross-reference stream, and a document with no verification URL are refused with 422 and a named reason; the ceiling on the upload is 2 MB.

get.description: The document's pipeline steps (BUILD_SPEC 7.2), by step number: state, when each became applicable, attempts out of the retry budget, the backoff a failed step waits for, and the fault that parked one.

post.description: Asks for a pipeline step to run against an existing document: it clears the step's backoff so the next drain pass takes it. Only step 40, the submission, has a runner today. A completed step never re-runs (409), a parked step waits for a person (409), and a step whose retry budget is spent is not granted more by asking (409).
